title: The Einstein-Klein-Gordon coupled system: global stability of the Minkowski solution
version: arXiv:1911.10652v2, 25 February 2020; pages 1-3, 6-10, 16-18, 24, 157, 160 read through a page extraction
locator: Theorem 1.3 (p. 7); Sec. 1.3.8 pointwise decay (p. 16); Sec. 1.3.10 ADM energy, eq. (1.3.27) (p. 17); Sec. 1.3.11 Bondi energy, eqs. (1.3.30)-(1.3.31), describing Theorem 6.17 (p. 18); Theorem 6.1 and Theorem 6.2 statements (pp. 157, 160)
assumptions: Small, smooth, localized initial data satisfying the constraints; wave coordinates; mass parameter 1.
conclusion: Authors' claims: global regularity; modified scattering; E_ADM equals a Klein-Gordon profile norm plus metric profile norms; their Bondi energy increases from E_KG at late retarded time to E_ADM.
proof_status: Statements read. Chapter 6 proofs, including Theorem 6.17, not read.
relevance: Supports part (a) of the massive rigidity conjecture.
open_questions: Whether the metric scattering profiles vanish in spherical symmetry; whether their Bondi energy agrees with the Hawking-mass limit.
limits: About 20 of 190 pages. The authors say the relation of their Bondi energy to the Hawking-mass definition is unclear.

title: Gravitational Radiation Coupled to a real massive scalar Field
version: arXiv:2610.33928v1, 24 October 2026; pages 1-8, 17, 22, 25-31, 34-35, 37, 40-41, 46, 48, 51-52, 55 read through a page extraction
locator: Theorem 1.1 (quoted from their ref. 11), Theorem 1.2 and Corollary 1.3 (pp. 4-6); Lemma 6.1 (p. 22); Proposition 7.1, Theorem 7.2 (pp. 25-26); eq. (7.16) (p. 28); Proposition 8.3 (p. 34)
assumptions: Small data on a slice, equal to a Schwarzschild solution outside the unit ball, scalar supported inside; wave gauge; 0 < delta < 1/9.
conclusion: Authors' claims: the metric trace decays like 1/t with a non-negative profile U; the initial Klein-Gordon energy is bounded by a power of U at any single point; if U vanishes at one point the scalar vanishes identically.
proof_status: Unrefereed preprint. Read: statements of Theorems 1.1, 1.2, 7.2, 7.6, Propositions 5.1, 7.1, 7.3, 7.5, 8.1, 8.3, 8.4; proofs of Propositions 7.3, 7.5, 8.4 and Theorems 7.6 and 1.2 as printed; part of the proof of Theorem 7.2. Not read: Sections 3-4, most of 5-6, and most of the appendices. No proof was independently re-derived.
dependencies: Their ref. 11 (LeFloch-Ma global existence), ref. 4 (Ionescu-Pausader), ref. 14 (Chen-Lindblad): not read.
relevance: Gives part (b) of the massive rigidity conjecture in its class, by time reversal (Corollary 4).
open_questions: Extension to non-compactly supported data; coordinate independence of U, which the authors flag.
limits: Three weeks old at the time of reading. No independent check of any proof.
